AUTHOR: Alaba
TITLE: Class-Aware Fish Species Recognition Using Deep Learning for an Imbalanced Dataset
REGION: Gulf of Mexico continental shelf, Brownsville TX to Dry Tortugas FL, USA
SPECIES: Gulf of Mexico reef fish (Lutjanus, Epinephelus, Mycteroperca, Haemulon, Seriola, Calamus, Balistes, etc.); 130 species in dataset, 82 evaluated
DATA: SEAMAPD21 (NOAA SEFSC) — 28,328 images, 130 species; Pascal VOC as secondary non-fish benchmark
V_EV: Sec. 4.3: 'The target area is also widely diverse in water depth, ranging from 15 m to 200 m [7].' Depth range only; no turbidity measure; no visibility-stratified results.
D_EV: Sec. 4.3: 'The dataset is divided into training, validation, and testing in a 70/15/15 ratio.'; Sec. 5.1: 'When we randomly split the dataset into training, validation, and test data'
R_EV: Sec. 5.1 / Table 1: fish results only on the SEAMAPD21 held-out split; 'Tables 1 and 2 show the experimental result of our model on the SEAMAPD21 dataset and Pascal VOC' (VOC is a non-fish benchmark, not an external fish test).
C_EV: no statement found (only IoU criterion given: 'We also use an IOU of 0.5 to measure a true positive prediction'; no confidence threshold, no false-positive or uncertainty analysis)
E_EV: Sec. 5.1: 'The commonly used evaluation metric in object detection is mean average precision (mAP), which we use to measure the model's performance.' Only mAP / per-species AP reported.
ARCH: SSD detection head with MobileNetv3-large or VGG16 backbone (300x300 / 512x512); proposed class-aware re-weighted cross-entropy + smoothL1 loss
METR: mAP, per-species AP (Table A1), inference FPS
NOTE: PLAT=NR: the paper only says the data is 'fishery-independent ... recorded from fish habitat, underwater'; camera platform (NOAA SEAMAP reef fish video survey) is not described in the text. NCLASS=82 is the number of species with reported AP (dataset has 130; species with <10 images lacked val/test samples after random split). V_ALL=P arises only from the depth range (15–200 m) quoted from the dataset paper; no optical visibility metric. Random image-level 70/15/15 split with no duplicate handling or leakage discussion → D_ALL=N. Pascal VOC evaluation is a generic object-detection sanity check, not an external fish-domain test (R1=N). Backbone pretraining not mentioned (PRE=NR). Only inference speed FPS reported, not video frame rate (FPS=NR). Dataset public at github.com/SEFSC/SEAMAPD21; no code release stated.
